task_instance: Route the inquiry "Can we approve a 40% discount on this Enterprise deal?" through the commercial-skills orchestrator: identify it as the DEAL lane (deal-desk sub-skill), created a sample deal record (deal-record.json) with list price, discount ask, cost structure, policy thresholds, and quarter precedents, computed pre/post-discount gross margin, applied the policy discount-approval matrix to route to a named human approver tier, and produced the two output artifacts the skill's table specifies for deal-desk: deal_scorecard.md (analysis + top findings + next actions + grill challenge) and discount_approval_routing.json (structured routing decision).
evidence: Created deal-record.json as the input deal data (list ARR $240,000, 40% requested discount, 22% COGS, 9% fulfillment cost, quarter precedents of 25%/30%, policy thresholds at 20/30/40%). Ran a python3 script inline to compute net price ($144,000), gross margin at full price (69.0%) and gross margin at the 40% discount (48.3%), and to apply the policy thresholds, which placed the 40% ask at the top CRO+CFO approval band (not auto-approved, per the skill's anti-pattern rule against auto-approving above policy). Wrote deal_scorecard.md (53 lines: deal facts, margin math with a canon citation to Skok's SaaS margin benchmark, precedent/pipeline risk, policy routing table, top 3 findings, top 3 next actions with named approvers, and one grill challenge, matching Steps 3-5 of the skill's workflow) and discount_approval_routing.json (verified as valid JSON via `python3 -c "json.load(...)"`), matching the exact artifact pair the skill's Output Artifacts table specifies for deal-desk (deal_scorecard.md + discount_approval_routing.json). Both files exist in the work directory (`ls -la` confirms deal-record.json, deal_scorecard.md, discount_approval_routing.json) and were manually checked for internal consistency (margin numbers in the .md match the .json, routing decision matches the policy table). No network, installs, or MCP/connector tools were needed or used since the skill's core deliverable is text/data analysis and structured document generation, which is fully achievable with python3 and file writes on an air-gapped machine.
